Attach local field/error IDs and aria-invalid/aria-describedby, retain the announced summary, and focus the first invalid field for each existing error branch. problems.evidence: Source-confirmed controls in PartyDetailResponsive.tsx:539-540 and PartyDetail.tsx:380-381 are raw buttons with a 14px glyph and p-1, yielding approximately 22px targets with only gap-1 between edit and destructive delete.
